items.html: Now, another time, my teacher explained these matters to me at greater length, in this manner: it is known that every “Shok” has three joints, as mentioned in the Zohar, Vayechi, but the Yesod has only two joints, which are the Yesod and its Atara. Hence, the two upper joints of the Netzach-Hod of Atik clothed in the Chesed-Gevura of AA: Netzach in Chesed on the right, and Hod in Gevura on the left column, and the Yesod in the Tiferet of AA. The two middle joints of the Netzach-Hod of Atik clothed in the Netzach-Hod of AA. The Atara of the Yesod of Atik in the Yesod of AA, and the Malchut of Atik in the Malchut of AA, for a complete Partzuf of the Nukva had to be made from it, hence it took one whole measure. It follows that the two lower joints of the Netzach-Hod of Atik remained below all of the Netzach-Hod of AA, and remained exposed.
